description: Use for a verifiable USD price and 24h change of a token (symbol, 0x address, or Solana mint). Not a rug, honeypot, or safety report — use rug_check for the full 0-100 safety report or honeypot_check for sellability. $0.001 per call via x402 on GET /price?token=. No free daily check. If a symbol or 0x address exists on more than one chain, pass chain (ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, solana); Solana mints use solana. Unknown or unpriced tokens return an error and are not charged. Invalid or failed calls are not charged. With no payment, the tool returns error=payment_required and the x402 Payment Required challenge for the HTTP route; pay that USDC amount, then retry the URL.

chain.description: optional: ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, solana. Pass it when the identifier exists on more than one chain; Solana mints use solana

name: token_price

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

title: Token USD Price
